role: CI gate: every `File.swift:NNN`-style citation in Swift comments and in docs/*.md / README.md must name a known Swift basename and a line number within that file's length.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Roots = args or Emuqu, EmuquTests, EmuquUITests. Python: lengths[basename]=max line count over roots; CITATION regex accepts `:N`, ` ~N`, `line N`, `#LN`; years 19xx/20xx skipped. comment_lines yields // lines and every line while a /* */ block is open. Unknown basename or line > max length -> broken. Also scans docs/**/*.md and README.md. Prints totals; broken -> stderr list + exit 1, else exit 0. Watch app sources are not in the default roots, so citations of watch files report 'no such file'. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile comment-citations.

flags.text: Only out-of-range lines are decidable; a citation to an in-range but wrong line, or to a file sharing its basename with a longer file, passes. Current run finds only 3 citations in the tree.

Scope gaps: EmuquWatch Watch App sources are neither scanned nor in the length index; Markdown is read only from docs/ and README.md (scripts/README.md and other .md files are not); any citation whose line number is 1900-2099 is skipped as a year.
